title: Raising a timber frame
scene: A small team raising the wall frame of an ordinary timber house in a village compound, two adults steady a post while another fits a beam from a stable low bamboo platform. Exposed joinery, natural-fibre ropes, hand tools placed safely aside. No king, temple tower or palace carving.
uncertainty: Frame, joinery, platform and working method are illustrative, not a verified structural reconstruction.
